overview:
Emerton Data is the digital, data, and AI consulting unit of Emerton Group, a strategy consulting firm founded by former BCG, Bain & Company, McKinsey, and OC&C directors. Headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Munich, New York, and Hong Kong, Emerton Data merges data science, business consulting, and software engineering to deliver bespoke solutions for private equity and corporate clients.

What sets Emerton Data apart from traditional expert networks is its integration of expert consultations with advanced data analytics and AI capabilities. The company executes technology due diligences for PE funds evaluating tech acquisitions, combining expert insights with data science to assess technology platforms, data architectures, and AI capabilities of target companies.

The Emerton Group generated approximately $20.2 million in annual revenue in 2025. The group operates as an independent partnership (self-funded rather than venture-backed), led by co-founders Aimé Lachapelle (Ph.D., 15+ years in Digital/Data/AI), Pascal (22 years consulting/industry experience), and Sébastien (18 years strategy consulting at Mars & Co, Bain, and Emerton).

history.narrative: Emerton Group was founded by directors from BCG, Bain & Company, McKinsey, and OC&C Strategy Consultants, with founding sector practices in energy transition, tech & digital, and industry. Emerton Data was created by three co-founders — Aimé, Pascal, and Sébastien — as the group's AI and data consulting unit, building on the group's established strategy consulting practice with advanced technology capabilities.
